# PNX-ProxyBlocker

![ProxyBlocker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zephyr-OP/PNX-ProxyBlocker/main/.jarbage/icon.png)

Blocks proxy connections pre-login on PNX servers. Fully open sourced to help the community.

## Installation

1. Download the latest release
2. Grab .jar from target/
3. Place the .jar file in your PNX server's `plugins/` folder
4. Restart your server

## How It Works

- Player tries to connect
- Plugin checks if they're using a proxy
- If proxy detected, connection is blocked before login
- If not, player proceeds normally

Note: This plugin blocks proxies only, not VPNs.

## Blocks
- Gophertunnel
- Bedrock-tool
- Lumine-Proxy
- Lunar-Proxy

## Building

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Zephyr-OP/PNX-ProxyBlocker.git
cd PNX-ProxyBlocker
./compile.sh
name: ProxyBlocker
